text: How do you make sure no single person can open the bank's secrets?
prefix: How do you make sure no single person can open the bank's secrets?

text: Picture a payments product installed by a script someone ran once.
prefix: Picture a payments product installed by a script someone ran once.

text: The master password sits in a text file on that person's laptop.
prefix: The master password sits in a text file on that person's laptop.

text: Months later, that person leaves the bank.
prefix: Months later, that person leaves the bank.

text: Then a disk fails.
prefix: Then a disk fails.

text: The database backup is there, but it cannot be read, because nobody kept the keys that sealed it.
prefix: The database backup is there, but it cannot be read, because nobody kept the keys that sealed it.

text: One person and one file: the keys end up either lost or leaked.
prefix: One person and one file: the keys end up either lost or leaked.

text: Now think of a treasure map.
prefix: Now think of a treasure map.

text: Tear it into five pieces, and give the pieces to five different people.
prefix: Tear it into five pieces, and give the pieces to five different people.

text: Any three of them can put the map back together.
prefix: Any three of them can put the map back together.

text: No one alone can, and no two can either.
prefix: No one alone can, and no two can either.

text: Vault, which holds every key and every setting in the system, opens the same way.
prefix: Vault, which holds every key and every setting in the system, opens the same way.

text: At install, Vault's opening key is split into five key shares.
prefix: At install, Vault's opening key is split into five key shares.

text: A key share is one piece of that key, useless on its own.
prefix: A key share is one piece of that key, useless on its own.

text: Any three shares together open Vault.
prefix: Any three shares together open Vault.

text: Each share goes to one person: a keyholder.
prefix: Each share goes to one person: a keyholder.

text: A keyholder keeps their share in their own password manager, and nowhere else.
prefix: A keyholder keeps their share in their own password manager, and nowhere else.

text: The bank chooses the keyholders, and makes sure no one holds two shares.
prefix: The bank chooses the keyholders, and makes sure no one holds two shares.

text: Nothing of this ceremony is written down anywhere: not the shares, not on the server, not in a log.
prefix: Nothing of this ceremony is written down anywhere: not the shares, not on the server, not in a log.

text: Vault also locks itself.
prefix: Vault also locks itself.

text: Every time it starts, it starts sealed: it holds everything, but can read nothing.
prefix: Every time it starts, it starts sealed: it holds everything, but can read nothing.

text: To unseal it, three keyholders come, and each types their own share.
prefix: To unseal it, three keyholders come, and each types their own share.

text: Until then, nothing that needs Vault can run.
prefix: Until then, nothing that needs Vault can run.

text: Setting things up needs one more key: a master key for the session.
prefix: Setting things up needs one more key: a master key for the session.

text: It is made from three keyholders' shares, used for that one session, and always revoked at the end.
prefix: It is made from three keyholders' shares, used for that one session, and always revoked at the end.

text: So no master key sits around, waiting to be stolen.
prefix: So no master key sits around, waiting to be stolen.

text: Last, backups.
prefix: Last, backups.

text: Card numbers in the database are sealed by Vault's keys.
prefix: Card numbers in the database are sealed by Vault's keys.

text: A database backup without that Vault is unreadable.
prefix: A database backup without that Vault is unreadable.

text: So the database and Vault are always backed up together, and restored together.
prefix: So the database and Vault are always backed up together, and restored together.

text: Let's watch the product.
prefix: Let's watch the product.

text: An operator runs the card zone's installer on a fresh server.
prefix: An operator runs the card zone's installer on a fresh server.

text: It checks the machine first, then reaches the keys.
prefix: It checks the machine first, then reaches the keys.

text: It says Vault is new, and that each of the five keyholders copies their own share straight into their own password manager.
prefix: It says Vault is new, and that each of the five keyholders copies their own share straight into their own password manager.

text: Then it waits: press Enter when the keyholders are here.
prefix: Then it waits: press Enter when the keyholders are here.

text: Five people gather.

text: From here, the camera stays on the people, never on the screen.
prefix: From here, the camera stays on the people, never on the screen.

text: Each person saves their own share.
prefix: Each person saves their own share.

text: The installer waits again, until every share is saved.

text: Then it clears the screen.

text: Three keyholders step up, one at a time, and type their shares unseen: first to unseal Vault, then to make the session's master key.
prefix: Three keyholders step up, one at a time, and type their shares unseen: first to unseal Vault, then to make the session's master key.

text: The installer sets everything up and starts the services.

text: At the end, it revokes the master key.

text: Now the operator restarts Vault, just as any reboot would.
prefix: Now the operator restarts Vault, just as any reboot would.

text: They run the installer's check.

text: It stops at once: Vault is sealed, and nothing that needs it can run.
prefix: It stops at once: Vault is sealed, and nothing that needs it can run.

text: Three keyholders are called.

text: One by one, each types their own share, unseen.

text: On the third share, Vault opens, and the check passes.

text: What does this protect?

text: It protects the bank from one person who leaves, loses a laptop, or is tempted.
prefix: It protects the bank from one person who leaves, loses a laptop, or is tempted.
